info.name: Story Spark AI — Backend / Server Routes
info.description:
## Backend Route Collection (Server-Side Testing)

Mirrors the Express module layout in `backend/src/router/index.ts` one-to-one. Built for **server-side testing**: every module is a folder, every route is a request, negative tests included.

### Server
| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Local | `http://localhost:5000` |
| Prefix | `/api/v1` |
| Auth middleware | `backend/src/app/middleware/auth.middleware.ts` — reads JWT **raw** from `Authorization` (no `Bearer`) |
| Rate limit | 100 req / 15 min per IP (global), tighter limits on auth + free-AI routes |

### Suggested Test Pass
1. Sanity folder — 404 fallback + unauthorized guard.
2. OTP → Register → Login chain (auto-saves tokens).
3. Public reads (posts, reviews, analytics).
4. Protected writes with `{{access_token}}`.
5. Role-guarded admin endpoints (expect 403 with a user token).
6. Validation failures (expect 400/422 with bad bodies).

### Response Envelope
```json
{ "success": true, "statusCode": 200, "message": "...", "meta": {}, "data": {} }
```

request.description: Auth middleware guard — missing Authorization header must yield 401 `You are not authorized to access`.
Tampered token must also fail with 401 `Invalid token`.
Preflight for an allowed origin (localhost:5173 is whitelisted in `app.ts`) must not be rejected.

item.name: 01 auth
item.description: Module: `backend/src/app/modules/auth` · Mount `/api/v1/auth` · Middlewares: loginRateLimiter, ipRateLimiter, validateRequest

request.description: Creates the account, sets refresh cookie, returns accessToken. Password policy: 8+ chars, A-Z, a-z, 0-9, special.
Negative test — password without uppercase/number/special must be rejected by Zod validation.
Primary token issuer for the test run. Saves accessToken to the collection.
Refresh rotation — raw refresh token in Authorization header.
auth() any role. Invalidates prior sessions.
Completes the reset with OTP token.
Valid OTP → verificationToken (15 min validity). 5 failed attempts max.
Negative test — wrong code increments failedAttempts and reports attempts remaining.

item.name: 03 user
item.description: Module: `backend/src/app/modules/user` · Mount `/api/v1/user` · Role gates: lists/delete/approve = admin+, others any authed role

request.description: Own profile via JWT (no id needed).
Promotes applicant to writer. Double-checked in controller too.

item.name: 09 notification
item.description: Module: `backend/src/app/modules/notification` · Mount `/api/v1/notifications` · Realtime via Socket.IO room user:<id>

request.description: amount in INR > 0; converts to paise server-side.
Negative test — amount ≤ 0 must return { success:false, message:'Invalid amount' }.
